messages:
Ava: hey team — quick sync: we need a tight micro‑agenda for the hybrid annual planning day so facilitators can prep. aiming for 3 breakout rooms + 1 plenary.
Rohan: +1. do we have AV confirmed for room B? last time the mic died.
Lindsey: confirmed with venue for a wired mic and backup speaker in room B. AV tech is on call from 08:30–18:00.
Dave: can we keep each breakout to 40m with a 10m overlap for transitions? that helped last year.
Ava: yes — proposed slots: 09:00–09:40, 09:50–10:30, 10:40–11:20, then 11:30 plenary. want to include a short async kickoff doc for remote folks.
Kai: love the cadence. remote folks need a clear watch party flow + Slack channels per room. can offsite-bot auto-create channels?
offsite-bot: I can create channels #offsite-room-a, #offsite-room-b, #offsite-room-c at 07:30 on the day. react with :thumbsup: to confirm.
Rohan: please create #offsite-room-b-camera for the hybrid camera feed and add ops@redwood.
Lindsey: facilitators: Ava (plenary), Rohan (room A), Priya (room B), Dave (room C). Priya is remote but ok to facilitate B with co-facilitator Dave.
Ava: Priya can't make it in person, so Dave will be co‑fac for B and handle the on-site material.
Dave: got it. I'll own printed namecards, flipcharts, and a spare HDMI dongle.
Ava: budget question — snacks for 45 ppl + a coffee cart for 3 hours. estimated cost ~ $850. anyone object?
Kai: fine by me. can we add vegetarian + nut‑free labels on platters?
Rohan: yes pls. also we need a parking pass list for execs. Lindsey can you coordinate?
Lindsey: I'll collect names by EOD Friday and share with venue.
Ava: facilitation prep note: please build 6 candidate prompts per breakout for the eval session so we can run quick regressions post‑offsite. low‑friction prompts that map to current OKRs.
Rohan: will add prompts to the shared doc. link: https://drive.company/offsite/agenda-draft — I'll tag folks.
Ava: remote runbook snippet (for facilitators):
```
- Mic check at 08:50
- Start recording at 09:00 (plenary + blocked breakout cams)
- Assign remote buddy for each room to relay chat questions
- If camera feed fails: switch to presenter screen share + call transcribe
```
Lindsey: can we add a short FAQ card in the welcome packet for hybrid participants about how to use the room cameras? I'll draft.
Kai: also recommend setting a hard stop on tech help (10m) during transitions — otherwise sessions run over.
Dave: logistics checklist I'm tracking: HDMI dongles (2), whiteboard markers (10), sticky pads, printed participant list, extension cords, spare projector bulb.
Ava: thanks — one more: we should run a 30m facilitator dry run next Wed 15:30–16:00 to walk the micro‑agenda and handoffs. can everyone commit?
Rohan: yes.
Lindsey: yes.
Dave: yes.
Kai: can do.
Ava: perfect. I'll send calendar invite and a short prep deck with the 6 minute lightning format and explicit handoff language.
Rohan: tiny ask — add a slide with fallback model routing examples for the product prioritization exercise (e.g., region fallback -> low-cost variant -> throttle). helps anchor decisions.
Ava: good call. adding that.
Lindsey: FYI — venue requested a final headcount 72h before. tagging reminder: @here please RSVP by Monday.
Kai: pinged teams that own cross-functional reps (sales, infra, legal).
Dave: can we also print the OKR cheat sheet (one pager) and put at each table? low effort, high payoff.
Ava: agreed — I'll get the one‑pager from product ops and send to print.
Rohan: closing loop on action items: Ava send invites + prep deck; Lindsey collect parking + draft camera FAQ; Dave logistics kit + co-fac for room B; Kai dietary labels + cross‑func invites; Priya will finalize breakout prompts with Rohan.
Ava: thanks all — we'll regroup after the dry run and finalize the microagenda. :spiral_calendar:
